summary: Deploy the Ansible MCP server by creating an AAP instance with spec.mcp.disabled: false and allow_write_operations (false, the default, is read-only; true lets the agent run jobs and change state), then check the aap-mcp deployment's pod logs.
questions: How do I deploy the Ansible MCP server on OpenShift?
Can the MCP server launch jobs?
Is the Ansible MCP server read-only by default?

answer_card.title: Deploy the Ansible MCP server
answer_card.answer_md:
Installed Operators > AAP > Create instance (e.g. `aap-mcp`), YAML:
```yaml
spec:
  mcp:
    disabled: false
    allow_write_operations: false   # true lets the agent run jobs and change state
```
Read-only is the default. Check Workloads > Deployments for `aap-mcp` and its pod logs.
